{{Quote|Their Guardian is ''attacking''!''"<br />"''Don't worry, you fool! The ''hover guards'' will take care of him!|[[Vlix Oncard]] and Tig Fromm, being attack by a disguised [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="The Ultimate Weapon" />}}
The '''hover guards'''<ref name="CSWE" /> (also spelled '''hoverguard''')<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated, Part 1">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> was a series of [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] produced during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They resembled large flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]], and each was equipped with a tiny [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor engine]] for propulsion. A pair of sensor [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were located on a hover guard's front panel, and a [[light stunning blaster]] hung down from either side.<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Tig Fromm]], an [[Annoo-dat Blue]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]], used three such units as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="The Ultimate Weapon" />
